subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Is PR #102160 sufficient to close #84569 without live WhatsApp long-model/fallback delivery proof while current WhatsApp isError suppression remains in source?
rationale: Current main clearly fixes major run-lifecycle pieces, but the concrete channel-visible fallback delivery path still has source-backed suppression and an open closing PR, so closing requires maintainer acceptance of proof sufficiency and issue-splitting boundaries.

options.title: Keep Open Pending WhatsApp Proof
options.body: Leave #84569 open, require a current-main or release build to demonstrate visible WhatsApp fallback delivery, and explicitly dispose of #94833 before closing.

options.title: Close As Runner-Fixed
options.body: Close #84569 as fixed by PR #102160 and require any remaining WhatsApp socket or final-error delivery failure to be filed against #87561 or a fresh issue.

options.title: Split Remaining Contract
options.body: Move the durable final fallback delivery concern fully to #87561, close #94833 as superseded if appropriate, and close this issue only after that maintainer routing is explicit.

recommendation.title: Keep Open Pending WhatsApp Proof
recommendation.body: Leave #84569 open, require a current-main or release build to demonstrate visible WhatsApp fallback delivery, and explicitly dispose of #94833 before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the current assignee and owns the broader final-fallback delivery contract issue that determines whether remaining work stays here or moves to #87561.
